theDefectsCaughtInMyOwnFirstDraft_before.defect: I committed a parenthetical citing a measurement I could not re-read: 'the measured Caldwell ST x3/TE x1/TN x1 and McLennan TN x1 situs_state values'.
theDefectsCaughtInMyOwnFirstDraft_before.whyItWasWrong: those values came from a probe of the txgio_parcel.situs_state COLUMN, but the sentence they sat in describes the situs ADDRESS-token rung. Two different fields, one sentence -- and the store read that produced the numbers was not re-runnable at the time of the commit (cortex held by a publish lease), so I could not re-verify it before shipping it.
theDefectsCaughtInMyOwnFirstDraft_before.disposition: REMOVED before commit. The ladder's comment now states the rung and the blocklist's rule without asserting a measurement, and names the blocklist behaviour instead of a count. If the census is re-measured (see leave_behind), the numbers belong in the close, not in a permanent code comment that no test can falsify.

theDefectsCaughtInMyOwnFirstDraft_before.defect: The not-a-state blocklist held fifteen entries of which exactly ONE (CT) could ever fire.
theDefectsCaughtInMyOwnFirstDraft_before.whyItWasWrong: addressStateToken checks `US_STATE_CODE_SET.has(code)` BEFORE consulting the blocklist, so an entry that is not a USPS code (ST, LN, RD, PL, CV, PT, SQ, TER, TRL, WAY, LOOP, BLDG) can never be reached. A guardrail that cannot fire is decoration, and the accompanying tests' own reason strings ('ST is a street suffix, not Connecticut') explained a behaviour that the code was not producing for that reason -- the test passed, the explanation was wrong, which is the shape that makes a later reader trust the wrong mechanism.
theDefectsCaughtInMyOwnFirstDraft_before.disposition: FIXED before commit: the set is {CT, FL} with a comment stating the rule that membership must be a USPS code; a NEW test asserts that invariant directly against the source, so dead entries cannot accumulate again; the two misleading reason strings are rewritten; and a positive test now drives the blocklist in both directions (CT/FL drop to null while TN/OK in the same shapes stay decisive), so the guard is proven able to fire.

theDefectsCaughtInMyOwnFirstDraft_before.defect: A typo in a code comment ('siteusState').
The first test I wrote for addressStateToken's ambiguity case asserted null and got 'TX' (the pre-fix regex matched the first state token before a ZIP when two were present).
theDefectsCaughtInMyOwnFirstDraft_before.disposition: fixed before commit by requiring a word boundary in the beforeZip regex; the test now pins the ambiguous shape as null in both directions (never a silent pick).

midWorkMeasurementsThatChangedThePlan.measurement: the two companion rails' unaccounted cells grouped by their PRIMARY's own basis
midWorkMeasurementsThatChangedThePlan.whatItChanged: the work shrank from 'fix acreageMethod/landUseSource in five counties' (which the refusal counts suggest: 2,274 / 21,398 / 23,182 / 25,775 / 114,254) to 'fix the join-miss cohort job-side (Hays, 433 / 636) and NAME the stale-store cohort, because a replay of the CURRENT code resolves it'. Without this grouping, the honest-looking move would have been to widen the completion step to any unaccounted companion -- which would have stamped absent-verified on cells whose primary was never verified absent at all, i.e. a fabrication with a plausible basis. The grouping is what makes the narrow predicate defensible rather than merely convenient.

theUnmeasuredFalsifier_statedRatherThanS.falsifier: 1 (dispatch): after the change, a dry run of each fixed writer for Bastrop reports writes for every parcel_record parcel on the three trivial rails, or names the ones it cannot write with the reason.
theUnmeasuredFalsifier_statedRatherThanS.why: the dry runs need read access to cortex (PRODUCTION_NEONDB_URL, ep-lucky-truth...). That endpoint has been under a job-execution lease held by factory-bastrop-publish-g68rt (a Travis publish) since 12:52Z, renewing continuously; every heavy-scan take returns 409 LEASE_HELD. The dispatch's own do-not list forbids scanning a store without a heavy-scan lease, so the runs are deferred instead of taken.
theUnmeasuredFalsifier_statedRatherThanS.whatWasDoneInstead: the whole dry-run campaign is prepared and armed (P:/tmp/p266p268-tools/dryrun-all.mjs: takes the lease with a 90-minute TTL, runs the six counties through fillrun.mjs, then parcel-r5-zoning, renewing between counties, releasing in a finally block, appending one progress line per step to the registered watch artifact). A probe invocation against the still-held lease exited 3 and logged 'LEASE NOT TAKEN ... nothing was read', which is the refusal working.
theUnmeasuredFalsifier_statedRatherThanS.whatTheCloseWillSay: if the lease frees before the close is filed, the dry runs' own JSON is the Falsifier-1 evidence and the prediction tables are read off it. If it does not, the close files Falsifier 1 as UNMEASURED with this reason, and the predictions are labelled as derived from the store census plus the code path rather than from a dry run. Either way the close's status is closed-partial: the dispatch's own definition of done is the integration seat's applies graded by the gate.

whatThisChangeDoesNotProve: That the integration seat's apply will write what the prediction says: only the dry run can, and it is deferred.

That the silent/out-of-state situsState populations are correct in the sense of 'those parcels really have no evidence' -- the ladder's rungs are only as good as cad_property.situs_address / situs_zip and txgio_parcel.geom. A parcel with no address, no zip and no geometry is left unaccounted, and the count of those is the honest residual, not a defect claim about the data.
That Hays's two companion cohorts (433 vs 636) are exhausted by the join-miss predicate. The residue is named as an OPEN thread rather than explained.
whatWouldMakeMeWithdrawTheChange: A dry run showing situsState still unaccounted at a whole-county scale (the wiring is dead), or showing a parcel with a TN/OK address token receiving 'TX' (falsifier 2 in the live data).
A dry run showing the completion step writing companion cells on parcels whose primary is absent-verified through a taxYear-bearing basis (i.e. the predicate is not the engine's signal after all).
A gate grade after the applies that counts MORE unaccounted cells on any of the four rails than the 07:29Z grade.
